{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Jungle''' was the name given to the large jungle located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. It was home to the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodins]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]].
